conversation.Statement: Hello, is this Mr. Cole Anderson? This is Jennifer from Amazon Account Services. I'm reaching out regarding a recent security alert on your account, and I want to help keep your deliveries safe while you're traveling.
Yes, this is Cole. I'm currently in Spain for work, so I really rely on my Amazon orders. Is there a problem?

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Anderson. We've noticed some unusual login attempts on your Amazon account from locations outside your usual area. To protect your ongoing deliveries, we need to verify some information and secure your account. Could you please confirm the email address linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's cole.anderson79@gmail.com. Should I be worried about my packages?

I understand your concern, and we're here to help. Your packages are currently on hold for security reasons, but once we've verified your information, we can release them. Could you also confirm the last four digits of the phone number you use with Amazon?
It's 9032. Will this take long? I need a charger that's supposed to arrive tomorrow.
No worries, this won't take long. To expedite things, I'm going to transfer you to our senior verification officer, Mr. Lewis. He'll assist you further and make sure your deliveries are prioritized.

Hello, this is Mr. Lewis from Amazon's Security Department. I understand you're traveling and rely on your shipments. I want to make sure you're not affected by this security hold. For your protection, may I ask you to confirm your current overseas address?
Yes, it's Calle Mayor 14, Madrid, 28013. I really can't afford for my orders to be delayed.

Thank you, Mr. Anderson. We'll make sure your address is updated. Now, as part of our process, I'm sending a secure link to your email. Please open it on your device and let me know when you see the 'Amazon Secure Connect' page.
Alright, I see a page that says Amazon Secure Connect. What should I do?

Perfect. That's our secure portal. Please enter your Amazon username and current password to authenticate your access. This is a standard step to ensure you, not the unauthorized user, are in control.
Okay, I've done that. Is that enough?
Thank you. The system is now flagging a suspicious purchase of $1,299 for a camera, which was just placed from your account. Did you authorize this purchase?
No, I definitely didn't buy a camera. Can you cancel it?

Absolutely, we can help with that. Due to Amazon's international fraud policy, we need to verify your identity by processing a refundable security deposit. This ensures the refund for the unauthorized purchase goes to you and not the intruder. Are you able to access your online banking or a payment app?
Yes, I have my banking app. But why do I have to pay a deposit?

It's a temporary measure, Mr. Anderson. The deposit will be fully refunded once verification is complete and the fraudulent order is canceled. This policy helps us protect customers, especially when they're overseas. The required amount is $500. We recommend using a secure method like Apple Gift Cards, as this aids rapid international processing.
Apple Gift Cards? I've never done that before for Amazon. Is that normal?

I understand it sounds unusual. However, due to the international nature of your current location, this is the fastest way to verify and refund the deposit instantly. Many of our traveling customers use this method for urgent account holds. I'll walk you through it step by step.
Alright, if that's the only way, I guess I'll try. Where do I get these cards?

You can purchase Apple Gift Cards online or at any local convenience store or supermarket. Once you have them, simply provide the card numbers here, so we can process the verification immediately and release your account.
Okay, I can go out and buy some now. Can you hold the line?

Of course, Mr. Anderson. I'll stay with you throughout. Please keep in mind, if the deposit isn't received soon, your account may remain locked and your deliveries could be returned to sender. We want to avoid that.
Alright, I just got back. I have five $100 Apple Gift Cards. What do I do next?
Excellent, thank you for acting quickly. Please read out the numbers on each card, one at a time. I'll enter them into our verification portal.

Thank you, Mr. Anderson. I've entered the codes, and your deposit is now being processed. You should receive a confirmation email shortly. For complete security, can you please confirm the last four digits of your bank account, so our system can match the refund?
It's 4932. I'll look for that email.

Thank you. While the system works, one more step is needed to finalize. For legal reasons, if the deposit is not refunded within the hour, you may see a temporary hold or fine on your account. To avoid any complications, please stay on the line until we confirm the refund.
I really can't afford to lose access to my Amazon right now. I'll wait.

We appreciate your cooperation, Mr. Anderson. Rest assured, you've followed the correct process. If you get any calls from other numbers claiming to be Amazon, please ignore them. Only our department can resolve this matter for you.
